onboarding.headerTitle: Let's get your business up and running
onboarding.headerSubtitle: Three steps. It takes under five minutes, and by the end you have the code ready to print.
onboarding.step1Desc: The name shows to whoever reviews you and signs the replies you send.
onboarding.phonePlaceholder: So we can reach you if something breaks
onboarding.step2Desc: This is where we send anyone who wants to leave a public review — whatever rating they gave. Paste your Google page address.
onboarding.googlePlaceholder: https://g.page/... or the Google Maps link
onboarding.googleHelp: Find your business on Google Maps and copy the address from the browser bar. The short g.page link works too.
onboarding.step3Title: The code to put on the table
onboarding.step3Desc: This is the code the customer points their phone at. Give it the name of the spot where it will sit, so you know later where each review came from.
onboarding.readyBody: It's ready. Print it, put it on the table or the counter, and reviews start reaching your dashboard.

awaiting.title_one: {{count}} customer left a contact and hasn't heard back

awaiting.detailGeneric: They took the time to write and left a way to reach them.
awaiting.action: Reply today, even without a solution yet. A same-day contact usually wins the customer back; a week of silence rarely does.

stale.detailGeneric: The case is still open on your dashboard.
stale.action: Resolve it or mark it resolved with a note of what you did. The record is what proves you acted.

ratingDrop.title: This week's average dropped to {{average}}
ratingDrop.detail: Over the previous four weeks it was {{baseline}}. That's a drop of {{drop}} point.
ratingDrop.action: Read this week's cases looking for what repeats. A sudden drop usually has a single cause: a shift, a dish, a person.

volume.title_other: {{count}} cases this week, against an average of {{average}}
volume.detail: The number of unhappy customers rose compared with previous weeks.
volume.action: Check whether something changed in the operation over the last seven days — team, supplier, hours, menu.

open.title_one: {{count}} open case with no customer contact
open.title_other: {{count}} open cases with no customer contact
open.detail: You can't reply to these, but the report still counts as a signal.
open.action: Read them, fix what's operational, and mark them resolved to keep the dashboard clean.

allClear.detailEmpty: As soon as someone rates "Bad" on the QR code, the case shows up here instantly.
allClear.actionEmpty: Make sure the QR code is visible on the table or the counter — it's what feeds this page.
allClear.actionClear: Take the chance to ask for a public review from anyone who had a good time. It's the best moment.

integrations.title: Integrations and external links
integrations.desc: Set up the links and infrastructure for external review platforms. A saved link doesn't mean automatic import is active.
integrations.googleDesc: The Google link may be saved, but automatic import only works once the Place ID, the Edge Function and the Google Places API key are all operational.
integrations.tripDesc: Set up the TripAdvisor connection or add reviews manually.
integrations.statusDesc: If the Google link has already been saved, it can be used to redirect customers. Automatic import in this tab still depends on the Place ID, a published Edge Function, and the GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY secret in Supabase.

qrcodes.title: QR codes
qrcodes.subtitle: Create and manage QR codes to collect reviews from your customers.
qrcodes.createDesc: Give the spot a name — table, counter, receipt — and we'll create the code ready to print. One per spot, so you know where each review came from.
qrcodes.savedDesc: Print, download or remove the codes you've already created.
qrcodes.empty: You don't have any QR codes yet.
qrcodes.emptyHint: Use the "Create QR code" tab to make your first one.
qrcodes.howToDesc: Tips for using QR codes effectively in your business.
qrcodes.onSiteDesc: Place QR codes on tables, counters or exit points of your business. Encourage customers to scan the code after service.
qrcodes.inMaterialsDesc: Add QR codes to business cards, receipts, product packaging, or any material customers take with them.
qrcodes.onlineDesc: Share the QR code image on your social media, website, emails or newsletters for customers who visited your business.
qrcodes.tipDesc: Create specific QR codes for different spots in your business or different campaigns. This helps identify where reviews come from and measure the effectiveness of each touchpoint.

reply.title: Reply suggestions
reply.copiedToast: Reply copied. Paste it wherever you're replying.
reply.copyErrorToast: Couldn't copy automatically. Select the text and copy it manually.
reply.footerPublic: AppReview doesn't publish replies on your behalf: the public reply has to go out from your Google business profile. Copy it, paste it there, and adjust what only you know.
reply.footerPrivate: This message goes straight to whoever wrote to you. Never offer anything in exchange for removing or changing a public review — that's against Google's rules and the law.
